RCE
Having access to communicate with the H2 database check this exploit to get RCE on it:
https://gist.github.com/h4ckninja/22b8e2d2f4c29e94121718a43ba97eed
H2 SQL Injection to RCE
In
this post
a payload is explained to get
RCE via a H2 database
abusing a
SQL Injection
.

        "advanced-options": false,
        "ssl": true
